name: Convert
description: Unit converter for length, mass, temperature, data, time and speed — both directions, live
author: Lattice

config.label: Significant digits
config.help: How many digits the answer keeps. 6 is enough for cooking and for wiring a plug.

sections.title: Two ways to use it
items: Type a number on the top row and read the answer on the bottom row.
Type in the bottom row instead and the top row answers — both fields are live, neither is read-only.
The ⇅ button swaps the two units and carries the answer up, so you can keep converting back.

sections.title: What it converts
items: Length, mass, temperature, data size, time and speed. The chips at the top switch between them.
Data sizes are 1024-based (1 KB = 1024 B), the way Windows reports file sizes.
Temperature is the one that is not a simple multiplication — Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin convert through absolute values.

sections.title: Significant digits
items: The answer keeps this many digits and drops the rest, so 1 m in feet reads 3.28084 rather than 3.280839895013123.
Very large or very small answers switch to scientific notation instead of running off the card.

sections.title: It remembers where you were
items: The last category and the two units are stored per widget, so reopening the card lands on the same conversion.
The number itself is not stored — a converter that reopens with a stale number is worse than an empty box.

changes: First release: six categories, both directions live, swap button.
Remembers the category and units, not the number.
